Hex has a layout revolving around a center room with [[LG]]. With 2 [[RA]] and 1 [[YA]], it has a relatively high density of armors compared to other maps. 

Creator {{player|alice|flag=se}} wanted to design it to have a bit more size to it to offer more tactical, creative play.
